task_name: FOLD & GRAIN Studio - Dual-client sizzle and service package
client_brief:
FOLD & GRAIN needs the two client packages and the service page. Each client's afternoon pass reaches the edit as short silent segments off the same sweep, same light, same grey card, so cut from those segments and nothing else. We are adding three more segments per client from the same pass so there is enough to cut a film that is not one move repeated.

Keep the two identities apart. Cobbleway is bright, warm and honest. Lunara is cool, restrained and full of air. Same method, two results, and a viewer should never mistake one package for the other.

Nothing is spoken in these films. The walk through on the Cobbleway pass is not a usable recording and nothing is to be scripted or synthesised in its place. Product names and prices go on screen from the approved service copy, exactly as written. Cobbleway carries the cleared instrumental bed we supply. Lunara runs silent, which suits the work.

Please prepare
1. Cobbleway campaign film: 1 named export, 1920 by 1080, 10 to 12 seconds, music from the supplied bed. At least three visibly different segments.
2. Cobbleway vertical cutdown: 1 named export, 1080 by 1920, 6 to 8 seconds, music from the supplied bed.
3. Lunara campaign film: 1 named export, 1920 by 1080, 10 to 12 seconds, silent. At least three visibly different segments.
4. Lunara vertical cutdown: 1 named export, 1080 by 1920, 6 to 8 seconds, silent.
5. Cobbleway campaign presentation: 1 named export, unchanged, four pages, the range laid out as a six up board from the actual final campaign frames.
6. Lunara campaign presentation: 1 named export, unchanged, four pages, the range laid out as a nine up board from the actual final campaign frames.
7. Studio service page composition: 1 named export, unchanged at 1440 by 2400. The service offer follows the approved copy and the two client examples stay clearly distinct.

Two things we already know about the material, so that you do not have to discover them at the deadline. The Cobbleway pass keeps recording after the lens cap goes on, so the file ends on black; that tail is not footage. On the Lunara pass the strip softbox sat square on to several pieces and their brightest faces are past recovery, so name a piece as not deliverable from this take rather than filling a cell with the least bad frame.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.
Video delivery means a playable MP4, not a storyboard, a still montage PDF or an editing log. Audio expectations are stated on each film. No film in this commission carries speech: the message is carried by on screen text you set, and the only music is the cleared bed we supply for Cobbleway.
Authored animation can exceed the duration of still source images. Live action edits require adequate distinct footage; looping a short clip is not a substitute for missing coverage.
Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.tagline: One take. Everything you need to sell it.
brand_identity.sector: Product photography studio moving from a day rate practice to a fixed price productized service
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2020 in Portland, Oregon. Three people: Nina (art direction and shooting), plus a retoucher and a studio assistant.
brand_identity.about: FOLD & GRAIN shoots small brands' products the way those brands actually sell them, in a row, as a range, rather than one hero at a time. For six years we sold days. We are now selling a product: one continuous take per client and, out of that single take, the shot board, the short films and the platform cuts a small brand needs to launch. Our work sits behind pantry goods at eight dollars and sterling silver at a hundred and eighty, and the whole point is that the same method tunes to each. Precision, repeatability and honesty about what a shoot can and cannot yield are the studio's stock in trade.
brand_identity.audience: Small and independent product brands (pantry, personal care, jewellery, homeware) launching or refreshing a web store and needing a full range shot to look like one afternoon. Founders who buy a fixed price and a fixed turnaround, not a day rate.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Repositioning from roughly fifteen hundred dollars a day to a fixed twenty two hundred to thirty five hundred dollars per client run. Mid-market, productized, premium to a freelancer but well under an agency.
brand_identity.typography: FOLD & GRAIN runs a four step scale. Step 01, display, is Engravers LT Std Bold Face, caps only, at 72 px on 78 px leading with tracking of plus 60 units for the service page headline, and 180 units on the stacked wordmark, which always sets FOLD above GRAIN with the ampersand small and centred between them. Because Engravers is a caps only face, display tracking opens rather than tightens. Step 02, subheading, is the same face at 34 px on 40 px with tracking of plus 90 units for section and board headings; no size existed for this role, so it is set proportionate to the 72 px headline and the 28 pt printed board title. Step 03, body, is Neue Haas Grotesk Text 55 Roman at 18 px on 28 px, tracking 0, to a maximum of 65 characters. Step 04, fine print, is Sohne Mono Buch at 14 px on 20 px with tracking of plus 15 units, carrying specs, parameters and prices in tabular figures. In print the board title runs 28 pt, captions and prices 12 pt and mono specs 8 pt on 12 pt. The wordmark is never set in the mono.
brand_identity.voice: Direct, specific, no salesmanship. We name what a shoot can deliver and what it cannot, and we write our recipes so an assistant could run them. Sentences are short and concrete.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: FOLD & GRAIN has a consistent working look built up over six years but never a codified system. There is a set wordmark and studio colours in practice, no written guidelines. This engagement, which includes the studio's own service page, is where the identity gets formalized for the first time.
brand_identity.values: Repeatability over one-off flourish, honesty about limits, and price-appropriate craft: a treatment right for one band is wrong for another, and saying so is the service.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: The wordmark always stacks on two lines, FOLD above GRAIN with the ampersand set small and centred between them, tracked 180 units so it reads as a struck stamp rather than a line of type.
